definitions.explanation: shipping payment collected from the recipient upon delivery

examples.japanese: {着払|ちゃくばら}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
⟦{送料|そうりょう}→送料：06128_souryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{着払|ちゃくばら}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Shipping will be collect on delivery.

examples.japanese: {着払|ちゃくばら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。

notes:
{着払|ちゃくばら}い means the recipient pays the shipping cost when the package arrives.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{着|ちゃく}→着：27655_chaku⟧ (arrival)
- ⟦{払|ばら}い→払い：09655_barai⟧ (payment)
- Literally: "arrival payment"

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {元払|もとばら}い (prepaid shipping - sender pays)
- ⟦{送料|そうりょう}→送料：06128_souryou⟧⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧ (shipping included)

USAGE:
- Package delivery
- Online shopping returns
- Used item sales (flea market apps)
- Business shipments

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {着払|ちゃくばら}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧ (send freight collect)
- {着払|ちゃくばら}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お⟦{届|とど}け→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧ (delivered collect)
- {着払|ちゃくばら}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不可|ふか}→不可：01922_fuka⟧ (collect not accepted)
- {着払|ちゃくばら}い⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ (collect OK)

IN ONLINE SHOPPING:
- Return shipping often {着払|ちゃくばら}い when seller at fault
- Buyer pays {着払|ちゃくばら}い for "buyer's remorse" returns
- Flea market apps: common for negotiating who pays

DELIVERY SERVICES:
- ⟦{宅急便|たっきゅうびん}→宅急便：17396_takkyuubin⟧ (Kuroneko Yamato)
- ゆう⟦パック→パック：11002_pakku⟧ (Japan Post)
- {佐川急便|さがわきゅうびん} (Sagawa)
- All offer {着払|ちゃくばら}い option

RELATED WORDS:
- {元払|もとばら}い (prepaid)
- ⟦{送料|そうりょう}→送料：06128_souryou⟧ (shipping cost)
- ⟦{代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}→代金引換：28163_daikinhikikae⟧ (COD - payment for item AND shipping)
- ⟦{配送料|はいそうりょう}→配送料：29242_haisouryou⟧ (delivery fee)

DIFFERENCE FROM {代引|だいび}き:
- {着払|ちゃくばら}い: Only shipping cost at delivery
- ⟦{代引|だいび}き→代引き：09721_daibiki⟧/⟦{代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}→代金引換：28163_daikinhikikae⟧: Item price + shipping at delivery

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in shipping and e-commerce contexts.
